title: Audit a schema document
summary: Reconciles one policy Fields section and its provider mirror against one fresh authoritative schema through an itemized human gate.

intent.goal: Produce one complete, source-current schema drift review without overwriting policy meaning or silently deleting documented intent.
useWhen: A governed schema document or provider mirror may have drifted from its authoritative instance.
excludeWhen: A record write, policy-authoring interview, or unrelated prose rewrite is the requested outcome.

procedure.outcome: Acquire the live schema, documented fields, and registered provider mirror from one current basis.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Compare every field, option, relation, writability rule, and registered template by stable identity in both directions.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Separate matches, missing fields, extra documented intent, type or option mismatches, and unconfirmed rename candidates.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Prepare only exact Fields, mirror, and freshness corrections while leaving unrelated policy content untouched.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Present the complete diff and hold every document, mirror, or template write for exact confirmation and verification.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

safeguards: Never trust a self-attesting consistency label as evidence.
Never equate rename candidates or delete extra documented fields without a human decision.
Never rewrite unrelated policy sections or perform a blind provider write.
limitations: This normalized definition preserves inspectable intent only; it has no operator runtime, provider binding, effect authority, or behavior parity.
The fingerprinted legacy source remains canonical until a separate implemented and evidenced runtime migration removes that fallback.
